gloss: to pull out; to withdraw; to draw out

definitions.gloss: to pull out; to withdraw (money); to draw out, elicit
definitions.explanation: To take something out from inside something else: money from an account, an object from a box or bag, or, figuratively, a quality or response from a person (ability, potential, true feelings, a promise).

examples.japanese: ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I pulled some old photos out from the back of the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す。
⟦ATM→ATM：08755_eetiiemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: I went and withdrew money from the ATM.

examples.japanese: ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}に→上手：00707_jouzu⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A good teacher can skillfully draw out the potential of their students.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す is a compound verb meaning to pull/draw out.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Related noun: ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧ (drawer)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す (withdraw money)
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す (draw out ability)
- ⟦{本音|ほんね}→本音：06620_honne⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す (draw out true feelings)

USAGE:
1. Physical: to pull something out
2. Banking: to withdraw money
3. Figurative: to elicit, bring out (potential, feelings)
